scope: PROVISIONAL review of localization source-age guards after canonical-clock SITL timing observations; not a P2 or GOAL stage exit by itself.

policy_after_review.qualification: PROVISIONAL P2 operational guards; propagated source age is 0.12 s after live SITL #81 measured up to 0.108 s receipt age and a false stale latch at 0.063 s; not frozen final acceptance limits

probe_guard_estimate.note: Probe subscriber timing is an estimate; the adapter may receive DDS samples at a different instant.

run_81_before_adjustment.interpretation: TRACKING latched LOST when an independently observed raw propagated sample was 63 ms behind /clock. Estimated receipt age was 59 ms in clock time, below the 200 ms receipt guard. The stale guard stopped adapter output even though raw VINS later resumed.

decision: Raise only propagated max source age from 0.05 to 0.12 s to cover the 108 ms observed sample-age tail while retaining a 0.2 s receipt guard. Keep both values PROVISIONAL; do not widen further from these runs.

verification_after_adjustment.one_second_propagated_dropout: PASS, synthetic Health state reaches LOST/propagated_stale with the 0.12 s source-age limit.

run_82.interpretation: The 0.12 s propagated source-age guard did not trigger; the adapter correctly latched imu_stale when the independent run saw an approximately 362 ms wall receipt gap, estimated at 0.211 s of ROS time, above the unchanged 0.2 s IMU receipt guard.

run_84.qualification: Localization remained TRACKING through the short 1.0 s pre-goal gate and action/trajectory shutdown smoke; not a long-run guarantee.

limitations: The 0.12 s propagated source-age value is not a frozen final acceptance limit.
Runs #81/#82 exposed occasional run-wide scheduling/receipt gaps; the clean-container #84 smoke was short and did not replace repeated-load or dropout-replay evidence.
No trajectory arrival, obstacle course, PX4, or hardware test is included.
